answer:
Yes, Wiggle & Snug typically offers a first-order promo code, usually obtained by signing up for their email newsletter.

**What it takes off:**
It generally offers **10% off** your first order.

**How to get it:**
1.  Go to the official Wiggle & Snug website.
2.  Look for a pop-up window or a banner at the top/bottom of the page inviting you to sign up for their newsletter.
3.  If you don't see one, scroll to the footer of the website – there's usually a "Sign up for our newsletter" section there.
4.  Enter your email address, and they will usually email you a unique 10% off code for your first purchase.

Always check their website directly for the most current and active offer, as promotions can change.
